implementation_scope: Local design mockup; existing Godot game and APK are not changed by this document.

world_contract.atlas_rule: Покажи невозможное со стороны — Атлас сделает его настоящим
world_contract.records: External observed appearance of real objects, not a private belief or erased memory.
world_contract.law_scope: Separate independently movable stone items contacting water within the same district; includes the vertically movable L01 step and L02 anchor. Fixed masonry, foundations, embankments and bedrock do not become floating props.
world_contract.load_support: Water magically holds an intact stone object and load placed on it at the surface. This is not inferred from ordinary buoyancy or an unspecified density change.
world_contract.L01_supported_load: Marfa and her one basket on a sufficiently broad and sound stone step.
world_contract.lateral_guides: Prevent sideways displacement; permit vertical motion; do not bear the stone weight.
world_contract.other_laws_or_capacity_models: Not established by this first-level mockup.

overlays.content: Current Marfa-perspective visibility; no automatic prop placement.
Presentation preferences supported by this mockup.
One contextual question about seeing stone while hiding support; no instant solve.
L02 premise and unchanged rope/wood; explicit end of this first-level design preview.

recovery_contract.undo: Revert the last screen modification; clearly unavailable if there is none. If implementation provides a reset instead, label it Сбросить постановку and disclose the starting fixture.

review_navigation.meaning: A review convenience, not an in-game bypass or proof of a valid player route.

acceptance_checks: Every truth-table placement matches the actual Marfa-view drawing.
Guides do not visually replace the removed float as vertical support.
Law effect and load support are observable before asking Marfa to cross.
Victory follows arrival, not valid trick or sealing alone.
Closed bakery art is not presented as an already opened door.
L02 consequence uses same district/law and does not falsely start chapter two.
False attempts can be corrected without losing scene state or inventing memory reset.
Dialogs, objective, controls and visual state agree on every exported frame.
